title: Order the road to remote
intro: From working local server to a deployed one any client can reach — put the steps in order.
prompt: Drag into order, first step on top.

steps.text: Working local server: tools/resources/prompts under stdio
Switch the run line: FastMCP(…, port=8001) + mcp.run(transport="sse")
Run it as an independent process — it must be up before any client
Deploy to a host (Render) and note the public URL
Append the transport path: …/sse (or /mcp/ for streamable HTTP)
Point the MCP inspector at the URL — list tools, call one, verify

debrief: The definitions never change — the journey is all operational: flip the transport, accept that the server now runs independently (nobody will spawn it for you), deploy, build the correct URL (the /sse or /mcp/ suffix is the step everyone forgets), and smoke-test with the inspector exactly as you did locally. If the inspector can list and call against the deployed URL, any MCP client in the world can too.
